findings.highlight: You said you’re going to fight him
findings.evidenceJa: そんなふざけたコト口走った
findings.governingReading: you blurted out something that absurd
findings.explanation: Rin’s condemnation of the reckless outburst and its involuntary delivery disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 固有結界から漏れた物にすぎない
findings.governingReading: are merely things that have leaked out of your Reality Marble
findings.explanation: The specific overflow mechanism behind Strengthening and Projection becomes generic derivation.

findings.highlight: I don’t have a magical element
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術の素養がない
findings.governingReading: I have no natural aptitude for Magecraft
findings.explanation: A lack of aptitude becomes possession of no undefined “magical element.”

findings.evidenceJa: わたしと貴方の問題
findings.governingReading: it concerns you and me
findings.explanation: The object of the preposition is put in the nominative case.

findings.highlight: even if my magical energy is depleted
findings.evidenceJa: 私の魔力が多少減っても
findings.governingReading: even if my magical energy is reduced somewhat
findings.explanation: A modest reduction is made complete depletion.

findings.highlight: I’ll still be able to fight
findings.evidenceJa: 戦力は拮抗する
findings.governingReading: our overall fighting strength will remain balanced
findings.explanation: A comparison of the two sides’ total forces is reassigned to Rin’s personal ability to fight.

findings.evidenceJa: お互いに移植すれば
findings.governingReading: one another’s essence
findings.explanation: A missing letter turns “another” into the flower-bearing part of a stamen.

findings.highlight: A person who gives up their Magic Circuits
findings.evidenceJa: 移植する魔術回路を提供する人間
findings.governingReading: The person who supplies the Magic Circuits to be transplanted
findings.explanation: Supplying the transplanted portion becomes surrendering all circuits.

findings.highlight: giving up their status as a magus
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師としての完成を放棄する
findings.governingReading: abandoning their own completion as a magus
findings.explanation: Loss of the family’s cultivated magical culmination becomes loss of social or categorical status.

findings.highlight: if this will settle things, then I won’t hesitate
findings.evidenceJa: それで済むのなら話は早い
findings.governingReading: if that is all it costs, the matter is simple
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds a declaration of resolve while blurring Shirou’s assessment of the bounded cost.

findings.highlight: I need to completely open my Magic Circuits
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路を全開にしてようやく追いつけるかどうか
findings.governingReading: even opening every Magic Circuit fully may only barely be enough
findings.explanation: The uncertain extreme requirement for Reality Marble deployment becomes a sufficient instruction.

findings.evidenceJa: 惜しい不正解
findings.governingReading: a close but incorrect answer
findings.explanation: Rin’s playful grading of the option as nearly right becomes a severe judgment.

findings.highlight: not really a part of me
findings.evidenceJa: 術者そのものでもない
findings.governingReading: not identical with the practitioner herself
findings.explanation: A technical distinction between crest and magus is reduced to bodily part-whole language.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術刻印を削る
findings.governingReading: shaving away part of her Magic Crest
findings.explanation: Partial sacrifice becomes removal of the whole crest.

findings.evidenceJa: 一族の悲願を後退させる
findings.governingReading: set back her family’s long-cherished ambition
findings.explanation: A reversible setback becomes total erasure, while the inherited project becomes a desire.

findings.evidenceJa: 物分かりいい顔
findings.governingReading: suddenly understanding expression
findings.explanation: Rin reacts to Shirou grasping her resolve; the English invents sympathy.

findings.evidenceJa: 扇情的だと思う
findings.governingReading: I find them sexually provocative
findings.explanation: Shirou’s explicit erotic perception becomes the false-friend “sensational.”

findings.evidenceJa: 高度な共感状態
findings.governingReading: a highly synchronized empathic state
findings.explanation: A technical state of mutual resonance becomes elevated pity or fellow-feeling.

findings.evidenceJa: うわずってしまいそうだ
findings.governingReading: my voice feels ready to pitch upward
findings.explanation: A specific involuntary vocal reaction becomes other people’s inferred impression.

findings.evidenceJa: 同調したあとに
findings.governingReading: After we synchronize
findings.explanation: A technical synchronization process becomes mutual fellow-feeling.

findings.highlight: I’m used to that kind of chaos
findings.evidenceJa: そういう荒事には慣れてる
findings.governingReading: I am accustomed to rough procedures like that
findings.explanation: Shirou’s experience with bodily trauma becomes experience of general disorder.

findings.evidenceJa: 吐息だけでなく
findings.governingReading: Not merely her breath
findings.explanation: The English invents depth and confuses continuous close breathing with a deliberate inhalation.

findings.evidenceJa: Vogel das
findings.governingReading: the ruby over “das” reads 招来, summon
findings.explanation: The incantation’s explicit Japanese reading means summoning; “engender” changes the ritual action.

findings.evidenceJa: in dem
findings.governingReading: the ruby over “dem” reads 第十六, sixteenth
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes the incantation’s ordinal from 16th to 60th.

findings.highlight: I hallucinate someone gripping my heart
findings.evidenceJa: 心臓が誰かに握られている幻視痛
findings.governingReading: a phantom pain as though someone were gripping my heart
findings.explanation: The operative pain is recast as visual or cognitive hallucination.

findings.highlight: I imagine myself gripping someone’s heart
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かの心臓を握っている幻経験
findings.governingReading: a phantom experience of gripping another person’s heart
findings.explanation: An imposed, quasi-sensory shared experience becomes voluntary imagination.

findings.highlight: I know it’s not my own breathing I’m hearing, so I listen carefully
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の吐息ではないと分かっていながら、つい耳を傾けてしまう
findings.governingReading: Although I know it is not my own breath, I cannot help listening
findings.explanation: A concessive relation becomes the reason Shirou deliberately listens.

findings.highlight: my arms were already folded up
findings.evidenceJa: 腕なんてとっくに折りたたまれているのでない
findings.governingReading: my arms have long since been folded away and no longer exist
findings.explanation: The loss of limbs is weakened into their merely folded state.

findings.highlight: I got rid of the excess things
findings.evidenceJa: 余分なもの、此処では無くてもいいものを削られてきた
findings.governingReading: extraneous parts unnecessary here have been stripped from me
findings.explanation: External disassembly is reassigned to Shirou’s own agency.

findings.evidenceJa: ひときわ大きな時間が揺れる
findings.governingReading: An exceptionally great mass of time trembles
findings.explanation: Both the motion and the crest-memory image are replaced.

findings.highlight: draws the design of the foreign substance
findings.evidenceJa: 異物の意図を汲み上げる
findings.governingReading: draws up and comprehends the foreign substance’s intent
findings.explanation: The crest responding to Shirou’s intent becomes extracting a visual design.

findings.highlight: being sent to a holiday villa
findings.evidenceJa: 別荘に置いて行かれた
findings.governingReading: being left behind at a villa
findings.explanation: Rin’s childhood abandonment is softened into purposeful travel arranged for her.

findings.evidenceJa: トラツグミ
findings.governingReading: scaly thrush
findings.explanation: The specific bird and its eerie cultural association are genericized.

findings.highlight: being locked up, bound, dismembered, disassembled, and played with
findings.evidenceJa: 圧縮され
findings.governingReading: locked, bound, divided, dismantled, compressed, and toyed with
findings.explanation: Compression disappears from the ordered mutilation sequence.

findings.evidenceJa: 急速に蒸発していく
findings.governingReading: rapidly evaporates
findings.explanation: The speed and physical metaphor of Shirou’s dissolving consciousness disappear.

findings.highlight: A design is branded on my left shoulder
findings.evidenceJa: 左腕には一線
findings.governingReading: A single ornate line is branded along my left upper arm
findings.explanation: The transferred crest’s location and linear form are changed.

findings.evidenceJa: 荒々しさの象徴みたいに言われる
findings.governingReading: be called as though I were the very symbol of brutish wildness
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic overanalysis of Rin calling him a beast disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 同調による共感状態
findings.governingReading: an empathic state produced by synchronization
findings.explanation: The procedure is again reduced to the false-friend “sympathized.”

findings.evidenceJa: 棒高跳びしてる
findings.governingReading: was pole-vaulting
findings.explanation: The Japanese explicitly names pole vaulting here; mirror moon changes the event to high jumping.

findings.highlight: a slash combined with a full swing
findings.evidenceJa: 居合いでありながらフルスイング
findings.governingReading: an iaijutsu draw delivered as a full swing
findings.explanation: The specific martial contradiction behind Rin’s pillow throw becomes generic slashing.

findings.evidenceJa: しゃくり上げるような枕アッパー
findings.governingReading: a scooping, rising pillow uppercut
findings.explanation: The attack’s exact motion is replaced by an inferred pain level.

findings.evidenceJa: だらしなくノックダウンする
findings.governingReading: I collapse in another limp, undignified knockout
findings.explanation: The comic physical manner of Shirou’s collapse disappears.

findings.highlight: I’ll look at your embarrassing memories next time
findings.evidenceJa: 恥ずかしい記憶を覗き返してやる
findings.governingReading: I will peek back into your embarrassing memories in return
findings.explanation: Rin’s promised retaliation becomes a neutral future act.

findings.highlight: I won’t go easy on you
findings.evidenceJa: 土下座をしても許さない
findings.governingReading: I will not forgive you even if you prostrate yourself
findings.explanation: Refusal of forgiveness becomes an unspecified refusal of leniency.

findings.evidenceJa: 廊下に放り出され
findings.governingReading: thrown out into the hallway
findings.explanation: The force and indignity of Rin’s ejection are weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな他愛ないことを独りごちながら
findings.governingReading: muttering that harmless little thought to myself
findings.explanation: The thought is characterized as slight and innocuous; the English instead calls Shirou’s manner stupid.

findings.evidenceJa: 柳洞寺
findings.governingReading: Ryuudou Temple
findings.explanation: The specific destination is reduced to a generic temple at the countdown transition.

findings.highlight: her maximum capacity could reach a thousand
findings.evidenceJa: 供給してくれるモノさえあれば、最大許容量は千に届くかも知れない
findings.governingReading: provided something supplies her, her maximum holding capacity may reach one thousand
findings.explanation: The stated condition that Rin needs an external source to fill that capacity disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 三十回、六十回と出来る
findings.governingReading: thirty, even sixty times
findings.explanation: The explicit scale of Rin’s support is replaced by an imprecise quantity.
